questions.stem: What is the perimeter of a rectangle with length $8\text{ cm}$ and width $5\text{ cm}$?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a rectangle is $2(l + w) = 2(8 + 5) = 2 \times 13 = 26\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: A regular hexagon has a perimeter of $42\text{ cm}$. What is the length of one side?
questions.explanation: A regular hexagon has 6 equal sides. Each side is $42 \div 6 = 7\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: Which formula gives the perimeter of a square with side length $s$?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides, so the perimeter is $4 \times s = 4s$.
